source.text: ወእምህየ፡ ሖርኩ፡ ማእከለ፡ ምድር፡ ወርኢኩ፡ *መካነ፡ ቡሩከ፡ [ጥሉለ፡] (ዘቦቱ፡ ዕፀወ፡) ዘቦቱ፡ አዕፁቀ፡ ዘይነብር፡ ወይሠርፅ፡ [እምዕፅ፡ ዘ*ተመተረ።]

translation.text: And from there I went to the middle of the earth[a], and I saw a blessed place, shaded[c][b], in which there were trees with abiding and sprouting branches from a tree that had been cut down.

footnotes.text: The Ethiopic text is difficult in the botanical description. The wording likely refers to shaded, living growth associated with a tree or trees; some details may also be rendered 'with trees' or 'with boughs/shoots.'
The final clause probably describes fresh growth coming from a tree that had been cut down, though the exact relation of the branches/shoots to the felled tree is textually difficult.

source.text: ወበህየ፡ ርኢኩ፡ ደብረ፡ ቅዱሰ፡ ወመትሕተ፡ ደብር፡ ማይ፡ እመንገለ፡ ጽባሕ፡ ወ*ውሕዘቱ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን።

translation.text: And there I saw a holy mountain[a], and beneath the mountain water from the east, and its flow toward the north.

footnotes.text: The Ge'ez says literally 'water from the east'; the following clause clarifies that this water has a northward flow.

source.text: ወርኢኩ፡ መንገለ፡ ጽባሕ፡ *ካልአ፡ ደብረ፡ ዘይነውኅ፡ እምዝ፡ ወማእከሎሙ፡ ቈላ፡ ዕሙቀ፡ ወ*አልቦ፡ ርሐበ፡ ወ*ቦቱኒ፡ ማይ፡ የሐውር፡ መንገለ፡ ደብር።

translation.text: And I saw another mountain toward the east[a], higher than this one; and between them was a deep ravine, but not wide[d][c][b], and water was flowing in it toward the mountain.

footnotes.text: 'Toward the northeast' reflects the directional phrase literally tied to dawn/east; 'toward the east' is also possible.
The comparison term may mean 'higher,' 'greater,' or possibly 'more extended/longer' than the first mountain.
The final clause is difficult. The Ge'ez most directly says that water was in the ravine and was moving 'toward the mountain.'

source.text: ወመንገለ፡ ዐረቡ፡ ለዝ፡ ካልእ፡ ደብር፡ ወይቴሐቶ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ኑሐ፡ ወቈላ፡ ታሕቱ፡ ማእከሎሙ፡ ወካእእት፡ ቈላ፡ ዕሙቅ፡ ወይቡስ፡ መንገለ፡ ጽንፈ፡ ሠለስቲሆሙ።

translation.text: And to the west of this was another[b][a],

footnotes.text: The Ge'ez is terse and does not explicitly name what 'the other one' refers to; the broader context may imply a feature in the vision, but the noun is not supplied here.
Or 'And the path of the west was for this other one.'.

source.text: ወኵሉ፡ ቈላት፡ ዕሙቃት፡ ወ*አልቦን፡ ርኅበ፡ እምኵኵሕ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ ወዕፅ፡ ኢ*ይትከል፡ ላዕሌሆን።
ወአንከርኩ፡ በእንተ፡ ኵኵሕ፡ ወ*አንከርኩ፡ በእንተ፡ ቈላ፡ ወጥቀ፡ አንከርኩ።
